translations.ja: 毎日聴いていた、あのいつもの笑い声も

translations.zh-TW: 每天都能聽見妳那熟悉的笑聲

translations.en: If you're not by my side, I'd probably die of loneliness

translations.zh-TW: 如果沒有妳陪在身邊，我一定會寂寞到死
translations.id: Jika tak ada dirimu di sisiku, aku pasti akan mati kesepian
translations.pt: Se você não estivesse ao meu lado, eu morreria de solidão
